novoe.ask_text: A short tour shows where the tools are, how to copy and save a screenshot and how to take one with the keyboard. It takes a minute.
novoe.ask_title: Would you like to learn about the program's other features?
novoe.forma_text: A button next to “Insert image” in the editor: rounded corners (with your own radius if you like), oval or circle. In PNG and on the clipboard the area outside the shape is transparent.
novoe.numbers_text: Each color has its own count: red numbers are counted separately from blue ones.
novoe.other_area_text: This is the new name of “Select again”: select another part of the screen. And “Save” no longer closes the selection window.
novoe.panel_text: The panel appears after {hotkey} once an area is selected. New buttons on it are marked “New”:
novoe.phone_editor_text: The “From phone” button in the editor: a photo or screenshot from your phone goes straight into this screenshot.
novoe.phone_editor_title: Photo from phone in the editor
novoe.phone_tile_text: A tile on the selection panel and a button at the top of the editor: take a photo with your phone camera or send a picture from it. Before sending, you can view the photo up close. From the editor the photo goes straight into the open screenshot.
novoe.subtitle: The highlights. New buttons are marked “New”.
novoe.title: New in version {version}
novoe.translate_head_text: The translation buttons in the editor are now in one row at the top: language, “Translation” and “Original”, “Copy translation”.
novoe.windows_text: “Open windows ▾” at the bottom of the selection panel: each window shows the program's icon and name. Pick a window and the frame fits it exactly. Key W.
